reviews.title: Honest real person review!!!    Bot filled spam
reviews.text:
Alright we are 1 day in right away you get a bunch of fake messages to get you to upgrade to premium. To reply. After you pay for premium it doesn’t stop there the bots continue to spam you with what they call smart messages. In reality it’s just a fake account you won’t get a response from. But it will ask you to “describe yourself using only 3 words?” And a bunch of other ones.  

The same girl/ bot account named marry has liked me and matched with me day one and day 2. And even when you are a premium package you get a message every log in or Home Screen to upgrade to gold. Out of a lot of dating apps this one has the most fake bot  accounts I have seen in a minute.

Just my honest review  canceled month subscription on day 2

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
On this app they let you select looking for people in your own city, but block seeing where people are from unless you pay. After paying you see that every person shown to you is actually 1000 miles away. Then you get “likes” and messages but later the thing written by that account disappears because (I think) the person never sent it. The app sent it to simulate activity. Oh, and paying doesn’t mean you see all your likes. Just some…unless you pay more…and they are all really far away as well. Skip it.

——

Oh, and the developer response of “not many users in my area” is hysterical when I live in CHICAGO. And the rest of it would suggest everyone is simply deleting their accounts and sending auto messages constantly. You would have done better to simply not respond. You look worse.

reviews.title: Premium only
reviews.text: Signed up for the app and everything looked perfectly fine and I was willing to give it a chance. Then I tried to message a match. And was prompted with the need to purchase premium to be able to even talk to anyone. So even if you do happen to match with someone you can’t communicate with them unless you subscribed to the premium service. What’s the point of this service being free if you can’t talk to the people you match with to set up a date? At that point just make it so that you need to subscribe at the App Store. Instead of this weird roundabout, BS. Would’ve saved me time and I wouldn’t have felt compelled to write this scathing review about an app trying to hide the fact that it requires you to pay money to use it.
